compatibility: Retains all v3.4 column names, units, null handling and task-metric semantics. Adds separately named FKeras score definitions; old versions are not reinterpreted.

estimator_predictions.csv.score: coordinate-dependent ordering magnitude of a decoded-weight Hessian projection; paper form has loss/weight units, repository form has an additional curvature factor. Repeated for all eight bits of one kernel word; not finite-bit loss damage or a calibrated cross-method quantity
estimator_predictions.csv.signed_prediction: null for FKeras; raw signed parameter projections are not signed finite-bit predictions

scientific_payload.json.estimator_definitions: FKeras definitions retain flat eigenvectors, signed eigenvalues, raw parameter scores, canonical tensor offsets/shapes/scales, source commit, HVP count, symmetry/orthogonality/residual diagnostics and solver options.
scientific_payload.json.runtime: wall time excluded from scientific payload; shared construction cost repeated across the two estimator rows, not additive

summary.json.mask_equivalence: actual membership equality at matching cardinality, per replication; full-tier degeneracy is not independent efficacy evidence
summary.json.fkeras_diagnostics: copy of numerical provenance, regenerable without TensorFlow
